look: a gentle halfling woman with warm peach skin, dark-blonde centre-parted hair gathered into a long ponytail, and a soft plump feminine build
dome: cap of dark-blonde hair combed back from a centre parting into a ponytail
skin_words: warm peach skin, its lighter highlights
face_tilt: the parted fringe of the hair, right under it the thin eyebrows and the smooth closed eyelids, then the small nose, and just behind the nose the lips and the front of the chin. Eyebrows, nose tip and chin sit close together, squeezed by the steep view, and the chin is the bottom edge of the head, with the chest starting directly below it. A small pointed ear shows at each side of the head.
torso_tilt: first the top of a soft rounded bust, then, below it, the top of a small round belly.
torso_paint: the torso as a soft bust resting on a small round belly, smooth and plump
face_paint: the head as soft matte dark-blonde hair with fine strand lines seen from above with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, the gentle face of a halfling woman strongly foreshortened from above: relaxed thin arched eyebrows, eyes closed as two fine lash lines, soft round cheeks, a small nose and a calm small mouth; the ears in the same warm peach as the skin
arms_paint: soft rounded shoulders across the shoulder band; smooth plump level arms

ponytail.guide: Behind the crown a long thick tail of gathered hair, bound by a dark band at its root, rises and falls away to the right, ending in loose strand tips.
ponytail.paint: the gathered hair as one long soft ponytail with loose strand ends, bound by the dark-brown tie where it leaves the head

fringe_lock.label: hair
fringe_lock.guide: The hair parts at the centre of the forehead and sweeps to both sides, and a loose lock hangs down past each temple to cheek level beside the face.
fringe_lock.paint: the fringe as centre-parted side-swept hair with a loose lock framing each cheek

notes: head-size rule: the legacy head frame (0.213 of the half span) is a circle on the hair mass; skull built at 0.180, hair cap x1.18
depth band widened to 0.311: with the legacy head size the humanoid figure is 0.299 deep (the head, not the camera, sets the depth)
hands_paint: each hand small and soft with five well-formed fingers and short fingernails
finish: chalky matte skin and matte hair
